title: Anaheim and Moen Recall Garbage Disposals Due to Impact Hazard

title: Vanguard Furniture Recalls Chests of Drawers Due to Serious Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards (Recall Alert)

title: Marin Mountain Bikes Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall, Crash Hazards
summary: The rigid front forks on these recalled bikes can bend or break during use or while jumping, causing the rider to lose control, posing fall and crash hazards to the user. Units: About 370 (in addition, about 100 were sold in Canada).

summary: The legs on the chairs can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,700.
